2011 World Car of the Year
100% electric. Room for 5 and speeds of up to 90 mph. The Nissan LEAFTM
is not just the world’s first mass market electric car, it’s the 2011 World Car
of the Year.1 In choosing LEAF for this top spot, the panel of automotive
journalists from Europe, Asia and North America described it as “…the
gateway to a brave new electric world from Nissan.” Let’s go.

range management made easy.
Nissan LEAFTM provides lots of info to help you get the most out of every charge and keep an eye on
your range. Of course, driving at moderate, more constant speeds is always a good idea. You
can also pre-heat or pre-cool the cabin, and use a moderate temperature setting while driving.
Then again, if you charge regularly, and know your daily driving habits, you’re good to go.
